name: Maizono Touma
source: Same grade as player. Handsome, smart, and athletic to boot, Touma was born with a multitude of talents and can seemingly do just about anything with natural skill. A particularly talented dancer, Touma has represented Japan at several international junior dance competitions, returning home with excellent results on each occasion.
